Kwindawo ethe tyaba engenalo ukungqubana, amandla athe rhoqo $F = 10\text{ N}$ asebenza kwinto enobunzima $m = 2\text{ kg}$ kumgama ongama-$4\text{ m}$. Yeyiphi ingxelo echaza ngokuchanekileyo umsebenzi $W$ nokukhawulezisa $a$?

20261121-physics-g05-1.material: [E5 Uphando Lwefiziksi (Phambili)] Uhlalutyo lwentshukumo yokuwa simahla enxulumene ne-Iziseko Zesantya. Into iwisiwe kwindawo engenanto phantsi komxhuzulane $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Yintoni isantya $v$ nomgama $h$ owileyo emva ko-$t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g05-1.s.s1.prompt: [E5 Uphando Lwefiziksi (Phambili)] Uhlalutyo lwentshukumo yokuwa simahla enxulumene ne-Iziseko Zesantya. Into iwisiwe kwindawo engenanto phantsi komxhuzulane $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Yintoni isantya $v$ nomgama $h$ owileyo emva ko-$t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g05-1.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Isantya $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Inyathelo 2: Umgama $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Inyathelo 3: Ngoko ke $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ kwaye $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
